correctness.rationale: The exact resultant of T^3-2 against (u-v)^2-T^2 w(u+v)-2T w^2 is (u-v)^6-16w^3(u^3+v^3+w^3), independently verified over Z. Applying coordinate permutations and v->omega^j v produces nine distinct block sextics. The coefficient of u^5 v is -6 omega^j, so exactly three equations are rational; each rational sextic has three distinct smooth conjugate conic factors transitively permuted by the cubic Galois subgroup, hence irreducible over Q. The full splitting field Q(cuberoot2,omega) is S3 of degree6; explicitly enumerated its action on 27 labeled components giving orbit sizes 3,3,3,6,6,6 and block orbits 1,1,1,2,2,2. The existing geometric freeness claim is credited to the published original, not independently reproved.
residual_risks: Relies on original primary source for smooth conics, exhaustive nine canonical blocks and freeness; checker does not reconstruct all local singularities.
Statements concern embedded Fermat-anchored plane equations, not abstract isomorphism fields.

The independently reconstructed exact arithmetic sextic products, minimal coefficient fields, rational irreducibility and six-component Galois orbit census are not given as such in inspected geometric theorems. Moe–Toft has general conic formulas but no compared explicit full descent. The result is an arithmetic characterization of an existing finite natural configuration, not freeness novelty.
